about: The communio of the formulary “Low Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Put out your hand and recognize the marks of the nails, alleluia, and do not disbelieve, but believe. Alleluia, alleluia.

ex.w014: Here fidelis contrasts with incredulus, “unbelieving”. It means believing or having faith, rather than merely being reliable.
